owners.independent_monitoring: Independent Compose client and UptimeRobot Free

grafana_provider.disposition: retain native Git provisioning; retain bounded API lifecycle for machine credentials
grafana_provider.reason: Dashboards, data sources, SSO settings and Prometheus alerts have native Git owners
grafana_provider.api_only_objects: Qualified candidate: Viewer service account and expiring token. No active machine consumer; no production API objects or provider root required
grafana_provider.custody: Vault owns issued tokens; interrupted issuance fails closed and requires explicit rotation

human_access.offboarding: Disable user and revoke Keycloak sessions; Grafana session expiry bounds retained access to 300 seconds
human_access.emergency: Independent local Grafana server administrator; vault password and stable encryption key
human_access.machine_access: Separate expiring Viewer service-account token; never reuse human OIDC credentials

credentials.keycloak-client-secrets: client_secrets JSON: platform.grafana and platform.kiali; retained identity owner

telemetry.secret_policy: Export only allowlisted fields; no tokens, passwords, request bodies, query strings or event representations

independent_monitoring.credential_scope: Account-wide Main API key; local management only, never sent to lab workloads
independent_monitoring.contact: One active Email contact matching the registered account email
independent_monitoring.endpoint: Uncached public /health checks web, API, SQL and S3; private services and human authentication need separate checks
independent_monitoring.fixture: Only /monitoring-proof/ready and /monitoring-proof/failed; never stop production to demonstrate an outage
independent_monitoring.notification_delivery: Provider status alone is insufficient; confirm failure and recovery emails before acceptance
independent_monitoring.tailnet: Hosted public monitoring has no private identity; private probes require separately authorized independent execution

native_gitops.trust: Platform-reviewed values; merged Helm schema does not establish per-file tenant isolation
native_gitops.activation: Parent remains skip-reconcile with automatic sync disabled until guarded writer handoff and identity DNS qualification
native_gitops.notifications: platformNotifications; disabled defaults; candidate transport requires qualified connections and existing dedicated Secret delivery before activation

notification_delivery.owner: Native monitoring chart renders Alertmanager configuration from platform-reviewed private values
transports: mesh-authenticated HTTP webhook after qualified connection enforcement
notification_delivery.webhook_targets: Nonretired charts/service catalog entries without composition; approved named TCP port and bounded path only; redirects disabled
notification_delivery.credentials: Existing cloudlab-observability alertmanager-notification-* Kubernetes Secrets; fixed derived paths; no inline values or vault provisioning
notification_delivery.state: Native 1Gi retained telemetry claim; legacy emptyDir unchanged; existing state preservation or verified-empty gate required before replacement
notification_delivery.activation_requirements: Qualified network enforcement, credential readiness, existing state preservation and Kubernetes storage lifecycle; transport fixtures alone are insufficient
notification_delivery.fixture: ansible/playbooks/observability/tests/compose.notifications-proof.yaml; no host ports or production destinations

service_observability.collection: Ordinary non-rollout charts/service definition.monitoring: shared normalized routes and explicit independent metrics/logs switches; default disabled. Generic traces require qualified ambient attribution and remain unsupported.
service_observability.native_inputs: Private platform/observability.yaml serviceObservability map: native rule groups and dashboard JSON keyed by current catalog service; platform-trusted PromQL checked with promtool, never templated. Stable svc- resource and dashboard identities. Severity uses info, warning or critical; default warning.
service_observability.ownership: Service catalog alone owns application namespace metrics isolation. Native configuration owns PodMonitor, collector egress and PrometheusRule; native Prometheus chart owns Grafana file provisioning. No separate inventory or operator apply.
service_observability.producer: Reviewed cloudlab-http compatible producer only; bounded metric family/dimension filters are not metadata, HELP, exemplar or producer-truth sanitizers. Exemplar storage disabled. Never export sensitive data.
service_observability.coverage: Missing, filtered or stale HTTP evidence is unknown; scrape up alone is not HTTP coverage. Readiness is readiness only; low traffic is distinct. Active alerts empty means no active observed alerts, not healthy or complete rule coverage.
service_observability.limits: Collection limits in policy.json. Native parent rejects aggregate JSON-encoded inline overrides above 192KiB, including notifications and adapters.
service_observability.activation: Prepared path remains paused. Owners synchronize independently, not atomically. Helm cannot parse PromQL; native admission is disabled. Server reload tests do not prove operator whole-revision preservation. Kubernetes discovery, policy enforcement, source handoff and lifecycle qualification remain required.
service_observability.logs: cloudlab-http-json-v1 accepts bounded request fields and fixed error codes; trace_id is optional. Catalog-derived identity and application-container selectors; raw bodies and supplied labels are discarded. Indexed service/kind and native canonical service_name only. Namespace Pod/log RBAC is catalog-owned and grants namespace-wide reads; selectors restrict collection.
service_observability.reload: Native pinned Alloy directory watcher reloads the external ConfigMap automatically. Rejected subsequent configuration preserves the running last-valid configuration with load-failure metrics; invalid initial configuration prevents startup. No durable last-valid cache across restarts.
